title: LongBench v2 query-directed labels answer-blind eligibility census
status: offline mechanical census only; no model/API calls; no accuracy or quality inference

safeguards.note: The dataset parser decodes each row as JSON, but application code copies only the allowlisted prompt and metadata fields; census code never selects, reads, uses, hashes, or serializes answer/key values or model outputs.
safeguards.held_out_note: Frozen held-out task text is processed mechanically for structural/token eligibility only. This is not an accuracy evaluation and provides no held-out quality evidence.

method.per_row_work: Count the full MiniMax-rendered prompt and run default Sift on every row; only rows over target run query-directed candidate compaction.
method.candidate_gate: Candidate uses the expected one-hop identity-label method, fits target, and is at most 110% of default Sift tokens.
method.raw_limit: max(1,000,000, exact full prompt token count), used only to permit offline compaction analysis; this does not qualify a prompt for live dispatch.

historical_route_cap.interpretation: Historical context-fit flags only; refresh current OpenRouter route metadata before any dispatch decision.

method.output_policy: Per-row metadata, task/prompt hashes, token counts, booleans, method names, and error/disposition codes only; no source or candidate prompt text.
